description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. Crypto Fear & Greed Index (alternative.me), current reading + optional history.

**Example:** `/v1/sentiment?limit=7`

Use when you want the crypto Fear & Greed reading as a quick market-mood signal. Not for asset-specific direction (use momentum_score).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

limit.description: Optional. Number of days of history (default 1, max 90).

name: sentiment
